mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, created_at from users where id = #{id}
select id, username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, created_at from users where username = #{username}
select id, username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, created_at from users order by id desc
select r.code from roles r inner join user_roles ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.id
select distinct p.code from permissions p inner join role_permissions rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join user_roles ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by p.code
select id from roles where code = #{code}
mapper.insert: insert into users (username, password_hash, display_name, enabled) values (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: select count(1) from users where username = #{username} and id != #{excludeId}
